name: decionis-commercegate
description: Seven commerce-action preflights, a D365 guard, and a marketplace SaaS offer preflight. Never writes to a marketplace or ERP.
long_description:
Decionis Commerce Gate gives an AI agent a policy checkpoint before a marketplace action or a manual Microsoft Partner Center or AWS Marketplace SaaS offer submission.

It checks seven kinds of commerce action in Shadow Mode: a price change, a stock change, accepting an order, a fulfillment step, a promotion change, a refund, or a return authorization. A separate Dynamics 365 tool returns enforced ALLOW or BLOCK for one complete transaction within the agent's spend budget. A separate marketplace SaaS offer-submission preflight checks the bounded offer, plan, public URL, platform identity, preview or test, and digest-backed release-evidence packet before a person submits it. Microsoft packets require Microsoft Entra tenant and application IDs. AWS packets require a Login with Amazon identity that is linked to the seller AWS account and IAM role.

Every policy decision can be recorded in a signed Decision Dossier. The marketplace-offer tool never calls a marketplace, uploads an artifact, creates or changes an offer, or submits an offer for review.

Setup: runs locally as a Node.js process. Capability discovery works with no credentials. On macOS, the first valid local Shadow evaluation can create a provisional workspace without registration and securely reuse it. Windows requires existing credentials until secure local persistence is supported. Trial limits apply; ERP requires owned access. Existing DECIONIS_API_KEY and DECIONIS_ORG_ID remain supported.

Built by Decionis for marketplace operations, pricing, finance and automation teams on Walmart Marketplace, Shopify, Adobe Commerce, Dynamics 365 Business Central, Microsoft Marketplace, and AWS Marketplace. Documentation: https://commerce.decionis.com/mcp

decionis_api_key.title: Decionis API key
decionis_api_key.description: Existing workspace key. On macOS, leave empty for provisional local Shadow access on first evaluation. Windows and ERP require owned access.

decionis_org_id.title: Decionis organization ID
decionis_org_id.description: The organization UUID every policy check is scoped to. Cannot be overridden by a tool call.

decionis_api_base.title: Decionis API origin
decionis_api_base.description: Default API origin, or a dedicated HTTPS deployment with an optional exact /aws gateway prefix.

tools.name: commercegate_describe_capabilities
tools.description: What Commerce Gate can check, how it answers, and whether it is connected to a workspace. Works without credentials.

tools.name: commercegate_evaluate_action
tools.description: Check a price change, stock change, order acceptance, fulfillment step, promotion change, refund or return against policy in Shadow Mode before acting.

tools.name: commercegate_validate_erp_transaction
tools.description: Enforced ALLOW or BLOCK for one complete Dynamics 365 Business Central transaction within the agent's spend budget.

tools.name: commercegate_get_dossier
tools.description: Read the signed Decision Dossier behind a decision: why it was held, allowed or blocked and under which policy version.

tools.name: commercegate_get_proof_packet
tools.description: Read the proof packet for a dossier when finance or an auditor asks for signed evidence.

tools.name: commercegate_list_shadow_reports
tools.description: List what Shadow Mode would have held or blocked recently, and why.

tools.name: commercegate_summarize_shadow_reports
tools.description: Totals for a period: near misses, policy mismatches and the order value reviewed, to judge whether to turn enforcement on.

tools.name: commercegate_evaluate_marketplace_offer_submission
tools.description: Check a bounded Microsoft Partner Center or AWS Marketplace SaaS offer packet in Shadow Mode before manual submission. Never calls a marketplace or submits an offer.
